$comment: Cross-language authority for the device-cert / signed-device-list binary codec bounds. These are parsed on the .NET backend by Kodosi.Domain SignedDeviceListParser / DeviceCertificateParser, with canonical constants in Kodosi.Domain.IdentityWireFormat, from bytes produced by the Rust runtime (rustProcess/src/identity_core/wire_codec.rs + signed_device_list.rs). A mismatch silently rejects valid certificates at the registration endpoint, so both sides are pinned here: .NET ProtocolAuthorityTests.IdentityWireFormatMatchesProtocolAuthority and Rust rust_identity_wire_format_matches_protocol_authority. Changing any value is a wire-breaking change.
